kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 10% in 2025 due to the acquisition of VOXX. Organic sales at Gentex ($2.27B) declined by 2% due to pricing pressures and reduced export demand to China

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by 12% in 2025, primarily due to the VOXX acquisition which contributed $18.0 million. R&D represents 8% of sales

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: Operating expenses increased by 26% in 2025, primarily due to the VOXX acquisition, restructuring charges ($11.6M in severance costs), and integration costs

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to Gentex as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: Net income declined by 5% in 2025, decreasing from 17.5% to 15.2% of sales, due to investment losses ($14.1M in impairments) and credit reserves

kpis.explanation: Growth rate of FDM unit shipments

risks.title: Dependence on the cyclical automotive industry
risks.summary: Heavy reliance on a volatile automotive sector exposes the company to fluctuations in production and demand, directly affecting its performance.
risks.score_rationale: The risk ranks highest among cited factors, with 89% of sales tied to the automotive sector. The language emphasizes production volatility, shortages, and plant shutdowns. Recurrence and intensity are highlighted, with direct impact on results. High weighting given for a cyclical industrial sector.

risks.title: Potential loss of key customers
risks.summary: Dependence on a few large customers increases the risk of severe impact in case of contract loss or production decline.
risks.score_rationale: Three customers (Toyota, VW, GM) each represent more than 10% of revenue. The document specifies that losing any one of them would have a material adverse effect. Central placement in the 10-K and strong language justify the severity.

risks.title: Pricing and margin pressures
risks.summary: Pricing pressures from customers and competitors weigh on margins, despite cost reduction efforts.
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of persistent pricing pressures in the text, with a proven negative effect on margins. The language is firm. Less existential than customer loss, but structural. Linked to customer and competitor pressure.

risks.title: Component shortages and supply chain disruptions
risks.summary: Electronic component shortages and logistical constraints regularly disrupt production and deliveries.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as current and recurring. Direct impact on deliveries and production. Strong language documenting observed effects. Supply chain disruptions regularly affect operations.

risks.title: Technological evolution: cameras vs. mirrors
risks.summary: The rise of camera systems and autonomous driving threatens the company's core business, requiring rapid technological adaptation.
risks.score_rationale: The text acknowledges that camera-screen systems can replace mirrors, with regulations evolving in China, Europe, and Japan. The company admits to increasing competitive risk. A disruptive threat to core business.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and valuation
risks.summary: Strategic acquisitions (VOXX, BioConnect) carry risks related to integration, unrealized synergies, and achieving expected value.
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to the company's external growth strategy. The text mentions integration difficulties, synergy risks, and financing concerns. Language is cautious. Less existential than operational risks, but important for growth trajectory.

risks.title: Tariffs and geopolitical tensions
risks.summary: Tariffs and trade tensions, particularly with China, increase costs and threaten international competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs between the U.S., China, Mexico, and Canada are explicitly cited as increasing costs and harming competitiveness. Prominent placement in the text. Reciprocal trade measures directly affect 2025 results.

ai_positioning.summary: GNTX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report.
